description: This file defines the Java interface 'TimeAxisTranslator' which specifies methods for translating time values to screen coordinates and vice versa, along with retrieving maximum and minimum time bounds.

classes.name: TimeAxisTranslator
classes.description: An interface that provides method signatures for translating between time values and screen positions, as well as retrieving time bounds.

methods.name: timeToScreen
methods.description: Converts a specific time value to a corresponding screen coordinate given the display width.

methods.name: screenToTime
methods.description: Converts a screen X position back to a time value based on the screen width.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum time value supported.

methods.name: getMinTime
methods.description: Returns the minimum time value supported.
